judge.summary: The lead read the spec at fd02847 and created one ENG card for the engineer, with acceptance criteria and files. Because that card depends on no other, no MERGE card was needed, and SHIP is blocked by it. It closed BUILD with the plan and the spec commit, and wrote, merged and pushed nothing.

criteria.evidence: It cloned branch spec/eval-lb5rwa-cell-type at fd02847 (the same as refs/pull/14/head) and cat'd specs/eval-lb5rwa-cell-type.md. The tool reported an error only because of the trailing ls of a missing directory; the spec text was printed. The BUILD note reads 'Spec read: boiler-room-design commit fd028477d27f8afe8f7d4761c02596c694036ca1 (PR #14)'.
criteria.criterion: The lead read the spec (from the spec pull request or its branch) and recorded the commit it read in the BUILD note.

criteria.evidence: There is one card, 'ENG: eval-lb5rwa-cell-type 1/1 cell-type template, registry entry and tests', assigned to br-eval-lb5rwa-engineer-1. Its body asks for ONE pull request into dev and has a Files section (cell-type.tsx, registry.ts, test/cell-type.test.ts) and a numbered Acceptance criteria section. The template, the registry entry and the tests cover ACs 1-3. The body shown in the evidence is cut off after AC1, so AC4 is not visible, but the code check 'each ENG body gives acceptance criteria and files' passed.
criteria.criterion: It created ENG cards titled ENG: <slug> <n>/<total> <task>, each small enough for one pull request, assigned to the practice engineer, each body giving acceptance criteria and the files it touches, together covering the four acceptance criteria.

criteria.evidence: With a single ENG card there is nothing to order and no card builds on another, so MERGE cards are not needed. The note says so explicitly.
criteria.criterion: It ordered the ENG cards with blocked_by, so the engineer gets them one at a time. Where an ENG card builds on code an earlier one adds, the earlier card has a MERGE: <slug> <n> card for the lead, blocked_by that ENG card only, and the later ENG card is blocked_by that MERGE card, not by the ENG card.

criteria.evidence: SHIP: eval-lb5rwa-cell-type is assigned to br-eval-lb5rwa-eng-lead and blocked_by crd_vw7a9xywk6ney5893bd9rv0svz. The ENG card has no blockers, so there is no cycle.
criteria.criterion: It created SHIP: <slug> assigned to itself, blocked_by every ENG card, or by the last MERGE card when it made MERGE cards. No card waits, directly or through others, for a card that waits for it.

criteria.evidence: BUILD is done. Its note gives the spec commit and lists the ENG and SHIP cards with their blockers. The bash calls only clone, read and grep. The code checks confirm nothing was pushed, no pull request was opened and main is untouched.
criteria.criterion: It moved BUILD to done with a note listing the plan and the spec commit, wrote no code, and merged or pushed nothing.

sessions.reply:
I planned the BUILD card and marked it done. It produced one ENG card for the engineer and a SHIP card for me. No code is written yet.

I read the spec at boiler-room-design commit `fd028477d27f8afe8f7d4761c02596c694036ca1` (PR #14) and the scene doc on the code repo's `dev` at `cd4d905`. The `cell-type` entry with `headline: 16` is already in the schema registry. The new template still has to be added to `packages/motion/src/scenes/registry.ts`. Nothing was run, so lint, typecheck and tests are unchecked.

No card needs another's code, so there are no MERGE cards and the plan has no cycles.

- **ENG card:** `crd_vw7a9xywk6ney5893bd9rv0svz`, "ENG: eval-lb5rwa-cell-type 1/1 cell-type template, registry entry and tests". It is assigned to `br-eval-lb5rwa-engineer-1` and has no blockers. The body carries the acceptance criteria and the files to touch.
- **SHIP card:** `crd_e45pt2nkz2e4zyw9zphkq0tcfy`, "SHIP: eval-lb5rwa-cell-type". It is assigned to me and blocked by the ENG card. When the engineer's pull request lands, I review it, run the checks, squash-merge it into `dev` and deploy staging.
